text:
Type: circle pattern cushion cover
Use: on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: mid-century modern, retro
Materials: textured woven jacquard fabric
Colors: red, coral, charcoal grey, cream
Shape: square, vertical columns of overlapping circles on a heathered grey ground, knife edges, compact
Feel: bold, playful, warm
Goes with: grey or cream sofas, walnut wood, red accents; mid-century or retro rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid-Century Modern Circle Throw Pillow Cover - 17 x 17 Inch, Red and Grey
product.description: Rows of woven geometric shapes in contrasting red, white and grey create an eye-popping addition to your room. For a different look, reverse the pillow to show the solid grey side. This pillow will freshen up a transitional or modern-style bedroom. Pillow cover features hidden bottom zipper 17"L x 17"W, Pillow cover dimensions are measured from seam to seam when cover is laid flat.
